description: Checks two to six job ideas against the market in Finland: for each idea, how many jobs are open now, the median stated pay, the skills ads for it ask for, and up to three real open jobs, ranked with the ideas that have openings first. Fits career changers: the ideas come from the person's own background (an audio engineer: game community manager, live events technician, podcast producer). Each idea carries the role, search terms and the reason it fits. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

gap.description: What they would need to show or learn, or empty when nothing.

query.description: Search terms for these jobs, like search_jobs "query".

role.description: The job title, in the user's language.

transferable.description: Their skills or experiences that carry over, in their words.

why.description: One line: which part of their experience transfers and how. Their facts only.

name: explore_career_paths

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.
